name: android-bridge
description: Android Gradle project support for the JetBrains Kotlin language server: correct project import, completion and references across modules, and a usages CodeLens.

androidBridge.gradle.javaHome.markdownDescription: JDK used to run the Gradle sync. Leave empty to use the same JDK as `./gradlew` (`org.gradle.java.home`, then `JAVA_HOME`, then the newest JDK 17+ found on this machine), which lets the sync reuse your existing Gradle daemon.

androidBridge.gradle.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra Gradle command-line arguments for every sync, for example `-Pfoo=bar`.

androidBridge.variant.markdownDescription: Build variant of the application modules, for example `prodDebug`. Library modules follow the variant the application consumes. Use **Android: Select Build Variant** to change it.

enumDescriptions: Also generate R classes, BuildConfig, view/data binding and AIDL (fast, no compilation).
Also run generate<Variant>Sources and KSP/kapt, which compiles upstream modules.
androidBridge.sync.generateSources.description: Which generated sources a sync produces.

androidBridge.sync.onGradleFileChange.description: What to do when build.gradle(.kts), settings or the version catalog change.

androidBridge.librarySources.markdownDescription: Attach library `-sources.jar` files that are already in the Gradle cache, so go to definition shows source instead of decompiled code.

androidBridge.androidSdkSources.markdownDescription: Attach the Android SDK sources (`<sdk>/sources/android-<api>`, install them with the SDK manager) so go to definition opens framework source. Makes the Kotlin server's index noticeably larger.

androidBridge.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a "N usages" CodeLens above Kotlin declarations.

androidBridge.codeLens.implementations.description: Also show "N implementations" above interfaces and abstract or open declarations.

androidBridge.codeLens.maxSymbolsPerFile.description: Skip the usages CodeLens in files with more declarations than this.

scripts.package: npm run build:sidecar && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
